2021-22.regulation: TAMIL NADU ELECTRICITY DISTRIBUTION STANDARDS OF PERFORMANCE REGULATIONS, 2004 (As amended upto 31-03-2024)

SAIDI.indicator_meaning: The average total duration of all sustained power interruptions experienced by a consumer in a month
SAIDI.standard_specified: Monthly limits of 600 minutes (Urban) or 1200 minutes (Rural).

SAIFI.indicator_meaning: The average number of sustained power interruptions experienced by a consumer in a month
SAIFI.standard_specified: Monthly limits of  15 interruptions (Urban) or 25 interruptions (Rural).

MAIFI.indicator_meaning: The average number of momentary interruptions experienced by a consumer in a month
MAIFI.standard_specified: Momentary outages of duration less than five minutes are specifically excluded from reliability index calculations.

CAIDI.indicator_meaning: Average restoration time for those consumers who experienced sustained interruptions.
CAIDI.standard_specified: Not specified with a numeric standard in the provided regulations.

VOLTAGE VARIATION.indicator_meaning: Maintenance of voltage at the point of supply within stipulated limits.
VOLTAGE VARIATION.standard_specified: Variation limits: Single/Three Phase & 11/22kV (+6% to -10%). Rectification within 48 hours if no network expansion/enhancement; 60 days if LT network upgradation/transformer/capacitor work; 120 days if HT network upgradation is required.
VOLTAGE VARIATION.benchmark_meaning: % of cases to be resolved within specified time/standard

HARMONICS.indicator_meaning: Distortions in the power supply.
HARMONICS.standard_specified: Not specified with a numeric standard in the provided regulations.

TRANSFORMER FAILURE.indicator_meaning: Restoration of power supply by replacing failed transformers in urban areas.
TRANSFORMER FAILURE.standard_specified: Replacement of failed distribution transformers within 24 hours in Corporation and Urban areas.
TRANSFORMER FAILURE.benchmark_meaning: % of cases to be resolved within specified time/standard

BILLING COMPLAINT RESOLUTION.indicator_meaning: Resolution of billing problems reported by consumers.
BILLING COMPLAINT RESOLUTION.standard_specified: Billing complaints received before the due date shall be resolved before the next billing, with refund/adjustment if any. Arithmetic errors received at least three days prior to the due date shall be corrected within the due date
BILLING COMPLAINT RESOLUTION.benchmark_meaning: % of cases to be resolved within specified time/standard
